reviews.text:
I visited with my dog shortly before closing time, because he was in pain and limping. The receptionist went back to see if the vet could quickly see us for an emergency check.

She came back saying the vet couldn't see us that day, as it was almost closing time. 'So you have to make an appointment for tomorrow. But it's still an emergency, so we charge extra.'

She didn't greet my dog, didn't show any concern, communicated that we weren't welcome, and sent me away with a lecture.

I had my first appointment with this vet, after leaving my previous vet due to a number of unpleasant situations. I am incredibly happy that I found this practice!

From the very first moment, I felt that the people working here truly love animals and do their work with a lot of love and attention. I noticed that difference immediately. My cat Appa is normally always very tense and anxious at the vet, making a visit often quite stressful. But at this practice, it was completely different. The vaccination went incredibly calmly and stress-free, something I honestly am not used to.

Veterinarian Hannah took ample time to listen to my questions and concerns and examined Appa very carefully. There was clearly attention paid to him as an animal, and not just to the reason for the visit. I found that personal and careful contact incredibly pleasant.

I left with a very good feeling and also noticed that Appa was much calmer than usual. For us, it is certainly a wonderful discovery, and I have every confidence that we have come to the right place here. Appa and I are extremely satisfied and will return here with peace of mind. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a dedicated, loving, and expert veterinarian! ❤️🐾
Your pet is in good hands here!
The veterinarian was very attentive, kind, and patient with the dog.

Fantastic veterinary practice, very skilled and dedicated staff. With love for your animal. I recently had to have my sweet cat put to sleep there; the vet and assistant were very loving towards him and also sympathized with me, for which I am very grateful!!!!!

Our dog Louie was suddenly paralyzed in her hind legs. We were able to come here urgently for a referral to a medical center. It turned out to be a herniated disc. We received incredibly prompt and excellent help from doctor Matthijs. Many thanks!

I’ve never had a bad experience at a vet since owning dogs for 15 years. They always just want to help the animal no matter what which I really appreciate. This vet is no different. Very caring, knowledgeable and friendly! I’ve been to 3 of their locations in Amsterdam west and south and all 3 have been wonderful!

Totally unprofessional advice... I contacted Stephanie at the reception desk multiple times for advice regarding my traumatized and rescued kitten. She acts as if I don't want to hear the truth, even though I am calling for a reason. Why would I call if I didn't want to hear the truth? First of all, that makes no sense. Secondly, she needs a dose of professional communication, and perhaps a little empathy for the owner as well. Because it isn't easy for us either. And the people who contact us do so from the heart, you know, for their pet. So being so condescending towards the owner is completely unnecessary.

We were at this clinic with our 6-year-old dog, who was feeling very unwell and had a lump in his stomach. The doctor, however, concluded it was poisoning and refused to fully control or investigate. It was Friday evening, October 11th, and the dog became very ill. We went to another clinic, where the dog underwent immediate surgery. It's a shame that doctors don't take enough responsibility for animals.
Dr Matthijs is very helpful and a great doc for our puppy George.

Louis is an amazing vet at this practice who has been especially caring for my Frenchie rescue, since adopting her two years ago. Kuna at the time was a little scraggly, infected ears, allergies and fleas - and didn’t like vets! Louis was always kind and patient. Thank you Louis!
Professional, knowledgeable and kind staff who give clear explanation about the diagnosis, how to treat it and what I can do. We always go here with our two cats.
